Trading is a waiting game. You sit, you wait, and you make a lot of money all at once. Profits come in bunches. The trick when going sideways between home runs is not to lose too much in between.
author: Michael Covel

quote: The stock market is a leading economic indicator. The stock market will tell you what the economy is going to do; the economy will not tell you what the stock market is going to do.
Don't let a bad day distract you from all the progress you've made.
Trading is not about being right. Trading is a game of math. It is about finding setups that offer you a good risk/reward and pulling the trigger.
author: Mike Bellafiore

quote: (1.00)^365 = 1.00. (1.01)^365 = 37.7. Doing nothing at all vs. small consistent effort
A stock going to a new high is typically a bullish event because the market has eliminated the supply of all previous buyers who had a loss and were waiting to get out at even.
author: Mark Minervini

quote: I know for a fact that my discipline in executing each and every trade according to my trading system is the secret to my success.
author: Tony Oz

quote: Sometimes it takes 10 years to finally reach that 1 year that will change your life.
Money is made by sitting, not trading.
author: Jesse Livermore

quote: You have to be extraordinarily patient with winning trades, and ruthless with losing trades.
author: Jon Boorman

quote: There is no better feeling than having a strong army of cash standing by waiting to move into action.
author: Jesse Livermore

quote: Keep things simple. The more you try to make things complex, the harder it will be for you to be successful. Keeping things simple works both in life and in the markets.
author: Van Tharp

quote: The older I get, the more I see a straight path where I want to go. If you're going to hunt elephants, don't get off the trail for a rabbit.
author: T. Boone Pickens

quote: If you have any attachment to money, and who doesn't, it is very tough to trade correctly.
author: Andy Abraham

quote: Trading is: 10% buying, 10% selling, 80% waiting.
Profits are better than wages
Trend charts always look most bullish at the top and most bearish at the bottom
Never trade temporary pleasure for permanent regret.
author: Dave Willis

quote: Luck is preparation meeting opportunity.
Take profits slowly, take losses quickly.

Don't ever average losers. Decrease your trading volume when you are trading poorly; increase your volume when you are trading well. Never trade in situations where you don't have control. For example, I don't risk significant amounts of money in front of key reports, since that is gambling, not trading.
author: Paul Tudor Jones

quote: There is nothing worse than a really bad trading day. You feel so low that it is difficult to hold your head up. But, if I knew that I could also have a similar experience in the exhilaration of winning, I would take the combination of winning and losing days any time because you feel that much more alive. Trading gives you an incredibly intense feeling of what life is all about.
author: Paul Tudor Jones

quote: You don't need to have a large edge to run a successful trading business; you do need to have a consistent edge.
author: Brett Steenbarger

quote: Trendfollowing is an extreme illustration of the Pareto principle. 95% of your profits could come from as little as 5% of trades. As a result you will spend most of your time handling small losses & not creating much progress. Most people are unable to accept that.
The goal is not more money. The goal is financial freedom.
Allow trading to support your lifestyle, not be your lifestyle.
You only need to know the direction, not the destination. The direction is enough to make the next choice.
author: James Clear

quote: A bull market is a bull. It constantly tries to throw off its riders.
author: Richard Russell

quote: Control your emotions or be consumed by them.
Success is really just a matter of habits. Trading is no different.
author: Nial Fuller

quote: Statistical studies of risk management have consistently demonstrated that most trading profits come from a small percentage of trades, approximately 3 to 10%, irrespective of the instrument being traded. These statistics point to the importance of maximizing profitability when the opportunity presents itself.
author: Ari Kiev

quote: Trading is not about winning every single trade, but approaching every trade with a winning formula.
You must accept that the market is not responsible for your wins and losses... you are the one in control.
author: Nial Fuller

quote: The game of speculation is the most uniformly fascinating game in the world. But it is not a game for the stupid, the mentally lazy, the person of inferior emotional balance, or the get-rich-quick adventurer. They will die poor.
author: Jesse Livermore

quote: If you wouldn't jump out of a plane without a parachute, then don't place a trade without a stop loss.
author: Nial Fuller

quote: Twenty years from now you will be more disappointed by the things that you didn't do than by the ones you did do. So throw off the bowlines. Sail away from the safe harbor. Catch the trade winds in your sails. Explore. Dream. Discover.
author: Mark Twain

quote: A trader who masters patience, masters everything else.

The key to trading success is emotional discipline. If intelligence were the key, there would be a lot more people making money trading... I know this will sound like a cliche, but the single most important reason that people lose money in the financial markets is that they don't cut their losses short.
author: Victor Sperandeo

quote: Your quality of life depends on your ability to say "No". And money increases your ability to say "No".
Someone is sitting in the shade today because someone planted a tree a long time ago.
author: Warren Buffett

quote: I don't exit a winning trade until I have a good reason to. I don't exit a losing trade until I believe I have been proven wrong through price action.
author: Steve Burns

quote: The worst thing you can do is being afraid of executing your trading system.
We actually use poker strategy in training our option traders, because we feel the parallels are very strong.
author: Jeff Yass

quote: Set a trading goal so big that you can't achieve it until you grow into the trader who can.
Someone's sitting in the shade today because someone planted a tree a long time ago.
author: Warren Buffett

quote: Think like the person you want to become.
May your equity curve have a slope steep enough to look like a totally unsustainable bubble.
author: Berkutchi

quote: Patience is the key to success not speed. Time is a cunning speculator's best friend if he uses it right.
author: Jesse Livermore

quote: The bear case always makes you sound smarter. And the best and most egotistical permabears sound the smartest.

When you really believe that trading is simply a probability game, concepts like right and wrong or win and lose no longer have the same significance. As a result, your expectations will be in harmony with the possibilities.
author: Mark Douglas

quote: Passion. Patience. Persistence. Profit.
It's crazy how powerful you can become with just an horizontal line.
Rule #1 Forget what they think
The two greatest mental skills of the pro-trader are patience and non-attachment.

The goal during a bear market is not to make lots of money, it's to survive with your account intact so when the next bull arrives you can compound capital instead of just digging out of a hole. Amateur traders want too much too fast. They are impatient and lack that vision.
author: Mark Minervini

quote: Most people who start trading, quit. Except you. Not. This. Time.
Knowing when not to trade is a skill in itself.
author: Steve Burns

quote: Focus on winning your next trade, not the money. If you have the skill, the money will follow you.
author: Nial Fuller

quote: All successful traders started as beginners. Trust the process and stay disciplined.
When you're right, have the patience to be right big. When you're wrong, have the discipline to be wrong small.
author: Olivier Tischendorf

quote: The great thing about being a trader is that you can always do a much better job. No matter how successful you are, you know how many times you screw up. Most people, in most careers, are busy trying to cover up their mistakes. As a trader, you are forced to confront your mistakes because the numbers don't lie.
author: Marty Schwartz

quote: A bull market is when you check the prices of your stocks every day to see how much money you've made. A bear market is when you don't bother to look anymore.
Never stop dreaming because life can go from 0 - 100 really fast
The market will always give you a second chance to enter a trade that you might have missed.
author: Nial Fuller

quote: All you need is one strategy to make a living.
To succeed, you only need to master one trade setup and focus on a handful of markets.
author: Nial Fuller

quote: We often overestimate what we can achieve in a year... and underestimate what we can achieve in 10 years...
To be the best you must be able to handle the worst.
Trading is not about picking the highs and lows on charts, it's about reading the charts from left to right.
author: Nial Fuller

quote: Trader: a smart person that risks their own money for freedom rather than exchanging their freedom for money.
3 out of 4 stocks follow the market
I'm not trading for money. I'm trading so I can do what I want, when I want.
Just because you took longer than others doesn't mean you failed
You spend years studying RSI, MACD, moving averages, BB, stochastics, etc. To realize that a simple line is more powerful than any indicators.
Don't expect 3-digit percentage returns if you cannot handle 2-digit drawdowns very, very regularly
I measure what's going on, and I adapt to it. I try to get my ego out of the way. The market is smarter than I am so I bend.
author: Martin Zweig

quote: Listen to what the market is saying about others, not what others are saying about the market.
author: Richard Wyckoff

quote: 99% of trading fear can be destroyed by thinking long term.
No profession requires more hard work, intelligence, patience, and mental discipline than successful speculation.

Why do casinos make consistent money on an event that has a random outcome? Because they know that over a series of events, the odds are in their favor. They also know that to realize the benefits of the favorable odds, they have to participate in every event.
author: Mark Douglas

quote: Master one price action trading strategy first. Trust it, master it, own it and believe in it completely.
author: Nial Fuller

quote: Why do you think unsuccessful traders are so obsessed with market analysis? They crave the sense of certainty that analysis appears to give them.
author: Mark Douglas

quote: The most dangerous time to trade is right after a big winner.
author: Nial Fuller

quote: After a stock market decline, people may perceive more risk than before when, in fact, the decline may have taken some of the risk out of the market.
author: Robert Shiller

quote: Here's the essence of risk management: Risk no more than you can afford to lose, and also risk enough so that a win is meaningful. If there is no such amount, don't play.
author: Ed Seykota

quote: The public is often right during the trends, but wrong at both ends.

For every mistake that you learn from you will save thousands of similar mistakes in the future, so if you treat mistakes as learning opportunities that yield rapid improvements you should be excited by them. But if you treat them as bad things, you will make yourself and others miserable, and you won't grow.
author: Ray Dalio

quote: If you have a losing position that is making you uncomfortable, the solution is very simple; get out.
author: Paul Tudor Jones

quote: The successful warrior is the average man, with laser-like focus.
Everybody in the world is a long-term investor until the market goes down.
author: Peter Lynch

quote: Trading life cycle. New trader: only strategy. Wounded trader: strategy & risk-management. Pro trader: strategy, risk management & psychology.

Real wealth is: -not having to go to meetings -not having to spend time with jerks -not being locked into status games -not feeling like you have to say "yes" -not worrying about others claiming your time and energy. Real wealth is about freedom.
Little edges make vast fortunes.
author: Henrique Simões

quote: Trend systems are difficult because of the comparatively low winning trade percentage and because profits tend to arrive in clusters. Academic research shows that streaky types of return streams have better returns on average because they are psychologically hard. In part, that is why they continue to work.
Wanting to surpass your peers can be the fuel of hard work. But life isn't any fun without a sense of enough.
Your mind is like a bank. What you deposit is what you can withdraw.
Behind every consistently profitable trader there is a lot of losses, mistakes and lessons learned.

I have patience. A moderately good strategy applied over the long term will generate more wealth than chasing the latest fad. The Eighth Wonder of the World is compounding. And compounding requires time to develop.
author: Nick Radge

quote: Learning: Nifty levels and what we seek. 12000+: 100 bagger. 11000+: multi bagger. 10000+: compounders. 9000+: FD + return. 8500+: break even. 7500+: 0 loss portfolio. What we should really seek or aim to achieve is exactly in reverse order.
Impatient traders are attracted by money while money is attracted to patient traders.
One of the tricks of this business is, keep your losses down and then, if you have a few good breaks, the compounding works well for you.
author: Walter Schloss

quote: If you don't deduct opportunity cost of time and effort in arriving the profit of a business, you're not counting profit, you're counting cashflow.

The typical trader doesn't pre-define his risk, cut his losses, or systematically take profits because the typical trader doesn't believe it's necessary. The only reason why he would believe it isn't necessary is that he believes he already knows what's going to happen next, based on what he perceives is happening in any given "now moment.
author: Mark Douglas

quote: Keep winning in private. Not everyone needs to know what you are up to.
Trading doesn't get easier, you get better.
Markets may initially trend for fundamental reasons, but prices overshoot by ludicrous amounts. At some point, prices go up today simply because they went up yesterday.
author: Michael Platt

quote: The key to success in trading is getting started
Most traders will repeat a mistake many times before the lesson finally sinks in.
author: Jack Schwager

quote: Frankly, I don't see markets; I see risks, rewards, and money.
author: Larry Hite

quote: Stress in trading is a sign that something is wrong.
author: Jack Schwager

quote: If you want to fly, you have to give up the things that weigh you down.
It's okay to be wrong; it's unforgivable to stay wrong.
author: Martin Zweig

quote: Successful trading involves loneliness. That's because you need to win the fight against your own emotions. Trading is a psychological business.
An idiot with a trading plan can beat a genius without a trading plan.
Because of the pain of loss, people are willing to take greater risks to reduce that pain and to avert it than they are willing to do to maximize their profitability.
author: Ari Kiev

quote: The impression has built up that the stock market is the cause of booms and busts. Actually, it is the thermometer -- not the fever.
author: Bernard Baruch

quote: Everything comes to you at the right time. Be patient and trust the process.
If you don't take risks you will always work for someone who does
He who wishes to be rich in a day will be hanged in a year.
author: Leonardo da Vinci

quote: One bad day is not a bad life
The only sound reason for my buying a stock is that it is rising in price. If that is happening, no other reason is required. If that is not happening, no other reason is worth considering.
author: Nicholas Darvas

quote: I made every rookie mistake in the books. Rather than taking the easy route and trading with the trend, I was trying to pick tops and bottoms, and I sat with losers and took small profits.
author: Scott Ramsey

quote: Most traders hold on to their losses too long because they hope the loss will not get larger. They take profits too soon, because they fear the profit will diminish.
Your only limit is your mind.
If you get on the wrong train, get off at the nearest station. The longer it takes you to get off, the more expensive the return trip will be.
Everyone times the market. Some people buy when they have money, and sell when they need money, while others use methods that are more sophisticated.
author: Marian McClellan

quote: You must commit to the belief that your trading edge will play out over time.
author: Nial Fuller

quote: The elements of good trading are: (1) cutting losses, (2) cutting losses, and (3) cutting losses. If you can follow these three rules, you may have a chance.
author: Ed Seykota

quote: You need an insane level of boredom tolerance to run a profitable algo portfolio.
If you can't measure it, you probably can't manage it...Things you measure tend to improve.
author: Ed Seykota

quote: Nobody can catch all the fluctuations.
author: Jesse Livermore

quote: It never was my thinking that made big money for me. It was always my sitting. Got that? My sitting tight!
author: Jesse Livermore

quote: Trader: a crazy person that risks their own money for freedom, rather than exchanging their freedom for money.
The only way you get a real education in the market is to invest cash, track your trade, and study your mistakes!
author: Jesse Livermore

quote: When you're ready to quit, you're closer than you think. There's an old Chinese saying that I just love, and I believe it is so true. It goes like this: "The temptation to quit will be greatest just before you are about to succeed.
author: Bob Parsons

quote: Bull markets convince amateurs that the market will never go down and bear markets convince them it will never go up.
author: Mark Minervini

quote: Like it or not, when you commit your money, you also commit your emotions.
author: Martin Pring

quote: To be a trader, you must lose your fear of being wrong. If you have an edge and are position sized right, there is nothing to fear.
Patience is also a form of action
Think big, believe big, act big, and the results will be big.
I profit because I'm not afraid of losing.
Strategy is a commodity, execution is an art.
author: Peter Drucker

quote: My experience with novice traders is that they trade three to five times too big. They are taking 5 to 10 percent risks on a trade when they should be taking 1 to 2 percent risks.
author: Bruce Kovner

quote: Traders who achieve the extraordinary are usually the most ordinary because they have nothing to prove to anybody. Be humble.
If you cannot control your emotion, you cannot control your money
The goal of a successful trader is to make the best trades. Money is secondary.
author: Alexander Elder

quote: Fall seven times and stand up eight.
Systems don't need to be changed. The trick is for a trader to develop a system with which he is compatible.
author: Ed Seykota

quote: Money isn't everything but everything needs money
Stop being afraid of what could go wrong and start being positive about what could go right.
Buy on the sound of cannons, sell on the sound of trumpets.
author: Nathan Rothschild

quote: Great profits never came from comfort zones.
Law of attraction: when you truly want something and go after it without limiting yourself with disbelief, the universe will make it happen.
Risk is a function of how much pain you can withstand in order to keep trading a strategy over the long term.
author: Nick Radge

quote: The goal isn't more money. The goal is living life on your terms.
If you can learn to create a state of mind that's not affected by the market's behavior, the struggle will cease to exist.
I have two basic rules about winning in trading as well as in life: (1) If you don't bet, you can't win. (2) If you lose all your chips, you can't bet.
author: Larry Hite

quote: It's you vs you. Everyday. Always has been.

Trading offers a succession of moments in which you can choose how to behave. Once you block out automatic beliefs, once you enter the next moment without regard for what you or others think and feel, you tap into a new dimension of power within yourself.
author: Ari Kiev

quote: One of the funny things about the stock market is that every time one person buys, another sells, and both think they are astute.
author: William Feather

quote: If you don't trust yourself or your methods, you will not find the emotional resilience to weather periods of loss.
author: Brett Steenbarger

quote: A river cuts through rocks not because of its power, but because of its persistence.
Successful trading is always an emotional battle for the speculator, not an intelligent battle. He knew that his biggest enemy was his own emotions.
author: Jesse Livermore

quote: The winners have attained a mind-set—a unique set of attitudes—that allows them to remain disciplined, focused, and, above all, confident in spite of the adverse conditions. As a result, they are no longer susceptible to the common fears and trading errors that plague everyone else.
author: Mark Douglas

quote: If you can't take a small loss, sooner or later you will take the mother of all losses.
author: Ed Seykota

quote: Every profitable trader started as an amateur
Once you become fearless you become limitless.
You don't need to be a rocket scientist. Investing is not a game where the guy with the 160 IQ beats the guy with 130 IQ.
author: Warren Buffett

quote: It's not whether you're right or wrong that's important, but how much money you make when you're right and how much you lose when you're wrong.
author: George Soros

quote: Most investors look for bargains instead of looking for leaders, and more often than not, they get what they pay for.
author: Mark Minervini

quote: In bear markets, stocks return to their rightful owners.
author: J.P. Morgan

quote: One of the best ways to stay aligned with the markets is to remove "I think", "I disagree", and "In my opinion (IMO)" from your thought process.
author: Chris Ciovacco

quote: To eliminate the emotional risk of trading, you will have to neutralize your expectations about what the market will or will not do at any given moment or in any given situation.
author: Mark Douglas

quote: Trade while they sleep, learn while they party, save while they spend, live like they dream
A peak performance trader is totally committed to being the best and doing whatever it takes to be the best. He feels totally responsible for whatever happens and thus can learn from mistakes.
author: Van Tharp

quote: Believe in yourself. You will become unstoppable.
The world's greatest traders have all walked the exact same path you're on right now.
author: Nial Fuller

quote: What has happened in the past, will happen again, and again, and again!
author: Jesse Livermore

quote: There is nothing new on Wall Street!
author: Jesse Livermore

quote: Your profits will grow when your experience grows.
The biggest risk is not taking one
If you need to ask someone whether we're in a bear market, we're not.

90% of traders talk about systems, indicators, setups, etc. The truth is that your emotions will always dictate the pace. You may have the best system in the world, but you will still be a loser if you can't execute.
Train yourself to avoid reacting emotionally to the highs of winning and the lows of losing.
author: Nial Fuller

quote: A bad system will beat a good person every time.
author: W. Edwards Deming

quote: Trading is a marathon, not a sprint.

Casinos make consistent profits day after day and year after year, facilitating an event that has a purely random outcome. At the same time, most traders believe that the outcome of the market's behavior is not random, yet can't seem to produce consistent profits.
author: Mark Douglas

quote: The market will destroy you mentally, before it rewards you financially. Only the strongest minds win.
One of the hardest parts of trading is having the patience to wait for the right moment.
Having money makes you rich. Having time makes you wealthy.
The stock market is never obvious. It is designed to fool most of the people, most of the time.
author: Jesse Livermore

quote: Average returns sustained for an above-average period of time leads to extraordinary returns.
author: Morgan Housel

quote: The only thing to do when a person is wrong is to be right, by ceasing to be wrong. Cut your losses quickly without hesitation.
author: Jesse Livermore

quote: If you want to be a good trader, don't study finance, study psychology

First of all, most traders don't have a winning strategy. Second, even among those traders who do, many don't follow their strategy. Trading puts pressure on weaker human traits and seems to seek out each individual's Achilles' heel.
author: Gil Blake

quote: Your job as a trader is to wait for the best trades. Money is made stalking and sitting, not being active and forcing a new trade each day.
Successful traders: 1 Wake up early 2 Stay disciplined 3 Stay laser focused 4 Live healthy 5 Ignore nonsense
There are no good or bad stocks, there are only rising and falling stocks.
author: Nicholas Darvas

quote: I can think of no psychological characteristic more important to long-term trading success than psychological resilience.
author: Brett Steenbarger

quote: No man ever reached to excellence in any one art or profession without having passed through the slow and painful process of study and preparation. Don't chase strategies after strategies. Don't predict outcomes, go with the flow and know that you have an edge. Be a good risk manager. Think long term. Let your winners run and cut your losers fast. Use system trading for creating wealth and not to win your daily bread.
author: Mark Douglas

quote: Speak these 4 lines to yourself daily: 1. I am the best. 2. I can do it. 3. I am a winner. 4. Today is my day.
Wake up, drink coffee, start trading.
Money in, money out. Money in, money out. Every winning trading regimen has both winners and losers. There's no other way.
author: Henrique Simões

quote: #1 reason why traders fail: They trade their emotions, instead of trading their systems.
Trending markets often move much further than anyone ever expects.
author: Nial Fuller

quote: Every moment in the market is unique, so the last trade is independent from the next.
author: Mark Douglas

quote: Your trading system pays you money. Your trading emotions steal your money.

The best traders can put on a trade without the slightest bit of hesitation or conflict, and just as freely and without hesitation or conflict, admit it isn't working. They can get out of the trade—even with a loss—and doing so doesn't resonate the slightest bit of emotional discomfort.
The older I get, the more I understand that it's ok to live a life others don't understand.
You don't entirely escape the emotional aspects of trading even if you're purely a systematic trader.
author: Peter Brandt

quote: Putting on a winning trade or even a series of winning trades requires absolutely no skill. On the other hand, creating consistent results and being able to keep what we've created does require skill. Making money consistently is a by-product of acquiring and mastering mental skills.
author: Mark Douglas

quote: When your desires are strong enough, you will appear to possess superhuman powers to achieve.
author: Napoleon Hill

quote: There is only one side of the market and it is not the bull side or the bear side, but the right side.
author: Jesse Livermore

quote: Building wealth is a marathon, not a sprint. Discipline is the key ingredient.
Focus on where you want to go, not where you are
If you're gonna do a thing, do it all the way.
author: Bobby Axelrod (Billions)

quote: You have to train your mind to be stronger than your emotions or else you'll lose yourself every time.
If expectations rise with results there is no logic in striving for more because you'll feel the same after putting in extra effort.
If you want big things you have to take big swings

Always remember, for each trade you are taking, there is somebody who is not only thinking just the opposite but also taking the trade in opposite direction. How can you be 100% sure of your trade? "Develop probabilistic mindset and cut your losses.
If people can tell by looking at you whether you're having a good or bad day in the markets, your positions are too big.
author: Richard Weissman

quote: Bull markets are like a cruise ship. Once they get moving, they are hard to slow down, hard to stop, and very hard to turn around.
Trade what you see, not what you think
You don't get paid for keeping ideas, you get paid for making them happen
We often over-estimate what we can achieve in 1 year. We often under-estimate what we can achieve in 10 years.
As a trader you need to have the ability to sit and do nothing.

The beauty of a bearish market is that long term investors who used to talk about 10 years are worrying about the next 1 year and short term traders have mostly become long term investors with 10 year view.
Most traders take a good system and destroy it by trying to make it into a perfect system.
The more you want something to be true, the more likely you are to believe a story that overestimates the odds of it being true.
author: Morgan Housel

quote: The common attribute of great business people including traders & investors, is their mindset.
author: Nial Fuller

quote: A great technical analyst cannot always be a good trader. A good trader is always a good risk manager -- it is what makes him/her a good trader. Trading and analysis are two different skill sets. A tiny percentage of traders possess both capabilities.
author: Peter Brandt

quote: He will win who knows when to fight and when not to fight.
author: Sun Tzu

quote: A real boss has no boss.
Risk is the price you pay for opportunity.

Losing money is the least of my troubles. A loss never bothers me after I take it. I forget it overnight. But being wrong - not taking the loss - that is what does damage to the pocketbook and to the soul.
author: Jesse Livermore

quote: First, they mock you then they ask you for advice

I visualized my grief if the stock market went way up and I wasn't in it—or if it went way down and I was completely in it. My intention was to minimize my future regret. So I split my contributions 50/50 between bonds and equities.
Growth is driven by compounding, which always takes time. Destruction is driven by single points of failure, which can happen in seconds, and loss of confidence, which can happen in an instant.
One of the best lessons you can learn in life is to master how to remain calm
A trader looks for consistency. The gambler looks for a quick profit.
If it doesn't affect your pay, don't let it affect your day.

The average man doesn't wish to be told that it is a bull or a bear market. What he desires is to be told specifically which particular stock to buy or sell. He wants to get something for nothing. He does not wish to work. He doesn't even wish to have to think.
author: Jesse Livermore

quote: Three months from now you will be in a completely different space: mentally, spiritually, and financially.
If you can't handle stress you can't handle success
One of the frustrating things for people who miss the first rally in a bull market is that they wait for the big correction, and it never comes. The market just keeps climbing and climbing.
author: Martin Zweig

quote: Money is like a shadow. When you try catching it, you can't, but when you move forward, it follows you.

The Law of Wasted Effort. Do you know that lions only succeed in a quarter of their hunting attempts — which means they fail in 75% of their attempts and succeed in only 25% of them. Despite this small percentage shared by most predators, they don't despair in their pursuit and hunting attempts.
Always be consistent. If you find that you are sometimes buying, sometimes selling in practically identical situations, then there is something terribly wrong with your discipline.
author: Stan Weinstein

quote: Trading systems don't eliminate whipsaws. They just include them as part of the process.
author: Ed Seykota

quote: I just want to be right—I don't care if the right answer comes from me.
author: Ray Dalio

quote: A brief guide to compounding: If you don't enjoy it, you won't stick with it. If you don't stick with it, it won't compound. Find the version of it that you love.
It's nearly impossible to be a really successful trader without the motivation to get away from excessive risk.
author: Charles Faulkner

quote: Psychology says, you become unstoppable when you realize that you can do it alone.
I don't work for money, I work for freedom.
Trading changes your life. The more you trade, the more you realize emotion control is power. If you can control your emotions, you can do anything.
Cut your losses quickly, without hesitation!
author: Jesse Livermore

quote: Many traders ride an emotional roller coaster and miss the essential element of winning: the management of their emotions.
author: Alexander Elder

quote: Success is always possible for the trader who refuses to give up.
As a trader, you are both the owner & the employee. As the owner, you create the rules & as the employee you have to do your job.
Ideas are cheap... It's the execution that is all-important.
author: George R.R. Martin

quote: Trading is like a marriage, you can't cheat on it and expect it to work.
An astute trader aims to enter the market during quiet times and take profits during wild times.
author: Alexander Elder

quote: Stay disciplined. You're not going to become a profitable trader overnight.
In this business if you are good, you are right 6 times out of 10. You are never going to be right 9 times out of 10.
author: Peter Lynch

quote: Everyday I assume every position I have is wrong.
author: Paul Tudor Jones

quote: Discipline is taking the trade no matter what your emotional state is.
Master your own self first & then you can master the markets.
author: Nial Fuller

quote: One day you will thank yourself for learning to trade.
Rarely will the typical trader stay with his system beyond two or three losses in a row, and taking two or three losses in a row is a very common occurrence for most trading systems.
author: Mark Douglas

quote: Good traders manage the downside, they don't worry about the upside.
author: Mark Minervini

quote: Your fear and anxiety on each trade only exists because you don't yet trust your edge and skills.
author: Nial Fuller

quote: I fear not the man who has practiced 10000 kicks once, but I fear the man who has practiced one kick 10000 times.
author: Bruce Lee

quote: It can be very expensive to try to convince the markets you are right.
author: Ed Seykota

quote: You are the CEO of your life. Hire, fire and promote accordingly.
Time only works in our favor in an uptrend. Other times patience can be a road to ruin.
author: Willie Delwiche

quote: When deciding to sell, people have control over whether to give themselves pleasure or give themselves pain, and they tend to give themselves pleasure. In other words, they tend to sell winners and hang on to losers. It turns out to be a bad idea.
author: Daniel Kahneman

quote: One of the qualities I've noted in highly successful traders is that they don't just follow markets; they also observe themselves. They keep rigorous score: they know how much they make or lose, and they identify what they do right and wrong.
author: Brett Steenbarger

quote: Be relentless in executing your trading strategy and don't become emotional about the winners and losses.
author: Nial Fuller

quote: A trader who really knows the strengths and weaknesses of his or her own strategy can do significantly better than someone who knows only a little about a superior strategy.
author: Mark Minervini

quote: To trade successfully you have to do it full-time.
author: Monroe Trout

quote: Success is the sum of small efforts, repeated day in and day out.
Sometimes it takes ten years to get that one year that will change your life.
By risking 1%, I am indifferent to any individual trade. Keeping your risk small and constant is absolutely critical.
author: Larry Hite

quote: No technique, system or method is ever going to work all the time. You must always be prepared for the inevitable drawdown periods and accept them as part of being a trader.
A few years of grinding can produce a lifetime of freedom
Profitable trading is simply being wrong small and right big.
History repeats itself all the time in Wall Street.

In the market, your mind is not your friend. Your mind is built for survival out in the open, its job is to protect you from harm at all costs. That's why trading rules are important—they're there to protect you against yourself.
You will make money faster by trading slower.
author: Nial Fuller

quote: Real wealth is not about money. Real wealth is: not having to go to meetings, not having to spend time with jerks, not being locked into status games, not feeling like you have to say "yes", not worrying about others claiming your time and energy. Real wealth is freedom.
There is only one way to protect your portfolio from a large loss, and that is to sell when you have a small loss before it snowballs into a huge one.
author: Mark Minervini

quote: Try to implement a set and forget trading approach on the majority of your trades.
author: Nial Fuller

quote: Trading dilemmas never end. A trader never solves all the issues standing in the way of greater success. It seems as though when one dilemma is resolved, another dilemma takes its place.
author: Peter Brandt

quote: The stock market will do whatever it has to do to embarrass the greatest number of people to the greatest extent possible.
author: Walter Deemer

quote: Regardless of what the strategy is, the main thing is that you go in with a plan.
author: Mark Minervini

quote: Anyone with average intelligence can learn to trade. This is not rocket science. However, it's much easier to learn what you should do in trading than to do it. Good systems tend to violate normal human tendencies. Of the people who can learn the basics, only a small percentage will be successful traders.
author: William Eckhardt

quote: The hallmark of a pro trader is to operate within your own circle of competence and ignore everything else.
author: Mark Minervini

quote: Money is a tool, not the goal. Freedom is the goal. Don't forget that.
We don't have to be smarter than the rest. We have to be more disciplined than the rest.
Everyone is a trader. Some trade time for a paycheck. Some trade happiness for security. Some trade risks for profits.
The best stat to evaluate and rank trading strategies is the Profit Factor ratio. Simply put, it compares the flow of money coming into your trading account, versus the flow of money going out.
author: Henrique Simões

quote: Rule number one: most things will prove to be cyclical. Rule number two: some of the greatest opportunities for gain and loss come when other people forget rule number one.
author: Howard Marks

quote: Stocks in uptrends are innocent until proven guilty. Stocks in downtrends are guilty until proven innocent.
author: Brian Shannon

quote: Trader: a person that risks their own money for freedom rather than exchanging their freedom for money.
A bull market tends to bail you out of all your mistakes. Conversely, bear markets make you pay for your mistakes.
author: Richard Russell

quote: Five fundamental truths: 1. Anything can happen. 2. You don't need to know what is going to happen next in order to make money. 3. There is a random distribution between wins and losses for any given set of variables that define an edge. 4. An edge is nothing more than an indication of a higher probability of one thing happening over another. 5. Every moment in the market is unique.
author: Mark Douglas

quote: A trading philosophy is something that cannot just be transferred from one person to another, it's something that you have to acquire yourself through time and effort.
author: Richard Driehaus

quote: The desire for constant action irrespective of underlying conditions is responsible for many losses in Wall Street.
author: Jesse Livermore

quote: In trading you have to be defensive and aggressive at the same time. If you are not aggressive, you are not going to make money, and if you are not defensive, you are not going to keep money. I believe that anyone who has made money in trading has had to experience horrendous pain at some point.
author: Ray Dalio

quote: We're in the regret business. If you buy and it goes up, you regret not buying more. If you buy and it goes down, you regret buying.
author: David Lundgren

quote: The eye sees only what the mind is prepared to comprehend.
author: Robertson Davies

quote: Don't blame your mistakes on the market.
author: Martin Zweig

quote: 10 years from now you'll look back and say I'm glad I started trading
